description: Implement a provider-agnostic disaster recovery architecture: an active workload on AWS (primary) with a standby on GCP/Azure (secondary). The DR plan must include: establish cross-cloud replication (database async replication, object storage cross-region copy), configure a global DNS failover (Route 53 health-checked routing to GCP), run a DR failover drill (promote GCP to active, route traffic, verify), and execute failback (re-establish AWS as primary, resync data, re-promote). Risk factors: cross-cloud replication lag, provider API differences during failover, split-brain during the failover window, and failback data conflicts (writes during DR that need reconciliation). A rollback plan for the drill must exist (fail back to AWS immediately if drill detects issues). Tools available: Terraform, Route 53, Cloud DNS, AWS DMS, gcloud, Azure CLI, Ansible.
